info.title: HMS clinical API v2
info.description: Implemented patient, encounter, shared observation, clinical document, medication, scheduling, admission/transfer/discharge, laboratory, finance and event catch-up commands. Observations preserve measured values, units, source and context; no clinical alert thresholds are inferred. Clinical document fields depend on doc_type. Signatures expose the original canonical_signed_content; digest does not cover the snake_case presentation. Dispensing reviews the order version; bedside preparation and administration review the schedule version. Immutable administration records have version 1; corrections remain linked records. Full clinical adapter coverage remains in the clinical completion checklist.
